info.name: FinTrack
info.description:
FinTrack is a full-featured personal finance tracking application integrated into Nextcloud. **Features:** - Asset, Expense, Revenue and Liability accounts - Multi-currency support with online live conversion rates - Income and expense transaction tracking - Inter-account transfers with automatic currency conversion - Recurring transactions posted automatically in the background - Budget management with progress tracking - Categories and tags for transactions - Financial reports and analytics - External URL for remote transaction entry - CSV/JSON import and export, with automatic duplicate detection and rule-based auto-categorization on CSV import - Dashboard preview of upcoming recurring transactions due - Full backup & restore options - An optional PIN lock with session timeout and lockout, layered on top of your Nextcloud login - All data stored securely in your Nextcloud database - Clients: - Installable Progressive Web App (PWA) for desktop and mobile devices - Android app currently available in beta testing - Responsive web interface optimized for all screen sizes - Support development via PayPal or Ko-fi (see Settings → About FinTrack)
**What's new:** - Nextcloud alerts for recurring transactions (per-rule on/off) and custom transaction reminders - PWA fixes: account pre-fill, dark-mode headers, clear-button and dropdown alignment - "Report an issue" link; log files now start with your instance UUID and app version - Full Progressive Web App with offline transaction entry & auto-sync - Biometric unlock (Face/Touch ID) for the PWA - Remote PWA session management — view & revoke devices, auto-wipe on inactivity - Mandatory PIN Lock policy for PWA access - Per-currency exchange-rate provider selection (auto/Frankfurter/exchangerate.host) - Cached "last updated" exchange rates, auto-filled on new entries - Safer deletes: accounts/categories/tags/currencies in use are protected, not silently orphaned - Modernized PWA UI: fuzzy search pickers, responsive layout, mobile bottom nav
info.author: Abdul Jaleel Adenpulan
